summary.text: Lou Raptakis is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 33 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Also known as Leonidas Raptakis, he owns and operates a pizza restaurant and has served in the Senate since 2013.

paragraphs.text: Leonidas "Lou" Raptakis earned an A.A. from the Community College of Rhode Island and a B.A. from Rhode Island College, both listed as 1981.
His professional experience includes owning and operating the Venus Pizza Restaurant.
Raptakis served in the Rhode Island House of Representatives from 1992 to 1996, according to Ballotpedia, and assumed office in the State Senate in 2013.
His current term ends on January 5, 2027.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee and vice chair of the Special Legislation and Veterans' Affairs committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
